case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Dralveck,

You wrote that your CNC machines are ready to put this job onto the shop floor, and Option A is built to keep them running on the HX pump shaft.

On quality:
Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).

On competition:
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

On material cost:
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.61; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve: with quality, a rival offer and falling bar prices on the table, it gives your shop this work at a price that reflects them.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Hallo, I looked at your numbers on the material and the other quote, and you make a fair point. We did not know that - a fair point. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. With the 14 days payment and 35 days lead time you offered, I can come down to €30.50 per unit. So our current Angebot is a price of €30.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Our current defect rate for you is about 1200 ppm. We take the complaints seriously; our 8D report is attached. 

Let me know if this works so we can get the machines running.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Dralveck,

You wrote that you need to clarify our proposal internally, so we have kept it simple for you to take upstairs: Option A pays you on a short payment term, which answers your wish for faster payment.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 26.92; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.11; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your shop a clear price on the HX pump shaft together with the short payment term you asked about.

For whoever has to approve this on your side: Option A gives Zerspanung Dralveck a firm unit price, quick payment on every invoice and a lead time you already know from your own offer. It is straightforward to accept as it stands, and it gives your machines work on a new series.

Mr. Dralveck, please take Option A up internally. We would like to find a solution that works for both family-run companies.

Just so you know, we will pay every invoice on its agreed due date.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Hallo, I am the owner here, so there is no upstairs to ask. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

To confirm Option A with the 14 days payment and 35 days lead time, I need a unit price of €28.00. So for our offer, that means a price of €28.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Let's agree on this so we can get the machines running on your new series.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH
